reviews.text: Intense tower defense action! Defend the portal from endless enemy hordes using powerful weapons and clever traps. Solo or co-op fun with satisfying gameplay and great variety
An action-defense game where you fight alone or in co-op to close mysterious world-spanning portals. Use an arsenal of upgradable weapons and traps to stop enemy waves.
Incinerate, slice, and gut anyone who tries to reach the portal. Unleash the full power of your arsenal and traps! Defend the portal by wiping out hordes of enemies!

Стражи портала не заставят вас скучать, сражайтесь в одиночку или с другом. Используйте разнообразный арсенал оружия и ловушек, чтобы остановить волны врагов. Порталы открылись по всему миру, закройте
Burn, slash, and eviscerate anyone who attempts to enter the portal. Unleash the full power of your arsenal and your traps!
